prompt: LibraryBook.java is provided and complete. Finish Catalogue.java so it owns the books and can add them without duplicate titles, find one by title, check a copy out, list an author's titles sorted, and total the copies on the shelf.
explanation: The Catalogue is the owner: it holds a private List<LibraryBook> that nothing outside can reach, and every question about the collection is answered by a method rather than by exposing the list. Reusing find() inside add() and checkOut() keeps the duplicate rule and the lookup rule in one place. Note that the catalogue never decrements a copy count itself -- it asks the book to takeCopy(), so each class guards its own data.
hints: Write find() first; add() and checkOut() both become two or three lines once you can look a title up.
String comparison uses equals, not ==, and find should return null when the loop finishes without a match.
titlesBy can collect matching titles into an ArrayList<String> and then call Collections.sort on it.
